# BPMN Desk 0.6.1

- **Consistent monitor catalogs and filters.** Definitions show the latest versions by default. Runtime and History have separate catalogs with compact collapsible filters and removable chips. Opening instances from a definition sets one shared, distinctively colored context across Runtime, History and dead-letter jobs; removing it clears that context everywhere.
- **Persistent summary toggle with diagram priority.** The highlighted toolbar button controls summaries across the app and remembers its state after restart. Summaries start after the selected diagram is displayed, use the connection's API timeout and participate in auto refresh. Unchanged data preserves diagram selection, zoom, scroll positions and badge DOM; refreshing connection settings preserves the canvas too.
- **History alongside runtime in definition summaries.** Element details have Runtime and History tabs. Summaries read up to 100 executions, 100 dead-letter jobs and 1000 recent historic activities, counting distinct instances independently for each source. Partial counts use `17+`; the tooltip explains the lower bound. Errors in one source leave the others available.
- **Readable badges on dense diagrams.** One badge combines grey History, green Runtime and red dead-letter sections with zigzag separators. A known runtime count remains visible alongside failures. Badges automatically avoid nearby shapes, labels and other badges; thin leaders identify their elements. SVG/PNG exports preserve the sections, positions and leaders.
- **Cleaner details and history interaction.** The definition details panel stays in place and shows a selection placeholder when empty. Instance fields use the same order in Runtime and History, with a link to the exact definition. The whole details panel scrolls instead of squeezing the journal into a small nested scroll area. Expanding a journal entry keeps other entries visible; selecting a diagram element still filters its history.
- **Selection and XML fixes.** Selected monitor elements have a clear outline consistent with the editor. Monitor XML has syntax highlighting and read-only search; replacement controls stay hidden. Definition/instance navigation sits beside the diagram name and version, and summary tooltips no longer repeat the canvas legend.

Summaries are bounded samples, not a full audit or an exact global instance total. History and runtime counts may overlap, and recorded ends do not establish success. Badge leaders may cross sequence flows on dense diagrams. No engine data is modified.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are built and tested by GitHub Actions. Windows executables are unsigned; manual installer acceptance is not confirmed. macOS is not available.
